answers.core:
I believe that it is possible to write an addon (for example gdscript plugin) that can do everything that the current `Find in files` can do and even more, including the proposal feature.

however, I believe that this is a matter of a couple of dozen lines for core feature versus hundreds of lines for an addon.
That is, creating an addon just for this feature would be like reinventing the wheel imo
So I am in favor of a "native" solution

title: TextEditor: add option to Find in files outside the res folder
